The '''Meridian Complex''' was a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] in the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], built after the [[Galactic War]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It was the main target of the Sith Empire's attack in a [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|decisive battle]] of the [[Third Galactic War|renewed conflict]].

==Description==
The Meridian Complex was a massive and towering [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] located alongside [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City's]] shoreline. It was composed of high corridors which make their way inward like a metallic labyrinth ending at the main production spire. The structure was developed by the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Tharan Cedrax]] and rumored to be derived from Iokath's advanced technologies. Once finished, it was able to produce [[Warship/Legends|warships]] three times faster than other shipyards and needing only a fraction of their energy consumption. Components for the shipyard were sourced from the salvage of [[Eternal Empire]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and its design won Cedrax the [[Silver Quasar Award for Excellence in Engineering]].<ref name="Gratitude">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=message|Deepest Gratitude|Tharan Cedrax}}</ref>

==History==
Finished at the start of the [[Third Galactic War|galactic conflict]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], it was seen by the Empire as a major threat and as such it became the location of a [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|decisive]] battle in [[3627 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
The ultimate fate of the Meridian Complex is determined by the player's allegiance during the "Jedi Under Siege" and "Onslaught" storylines. If the player is a loyal Imperial character, they will deactivate the shields and allow the Empire to destroy the complex. If the player is a loyal Republic character, they will raise the shields and the complex will be saved. Saboteur players can decide to support or sabotage their own faction by choosing either outcome.
